message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on a push broom for forklifts. Candidate headings are 9603 (brooms and brushes, including parts of machines, hand-operated mechanical floor sweepers) and 8479 or 8705 (machinery or vehicle attachments).

Heading 9603 covers "brushes constituting parts of machines, appliances or vehicles" (9603.50) and "hand-operated mechanical floor sweepers, not motor driven" (9603.10 covers brooms and brushes consisting of twigs or other vegetable materials bound together). Other relevant subheadings are:
- 9603.10: brooms of twigs or vegetable materials
- 9603.21: toothbrushes
- 9603.29: shaving brushes, hair brushes
- 9603.30: artists' brushes
- 9603.40: paint brushes
- 9603.50: other brushes constituting parts of machines, appliances or vehicles
- 9603.90: other, including hand-operated mechanical floor sweepers, mops and feather dusters (9603.90.80 and 9603.90.50 for other brooms and brushes)

The broom here is non-motorized and mounted on a host vehicle, so it is not a hand-operated sweeper. It is a push broom with a steel frame and polypropylene bristles. Under 9603.90, 9603.90.80 is "other" and 9603.90.50 is "Other: Brooms and brushes valued over 40 cents each". I believe 9603.90.8050 and 9603.90.9100 are the actual ones, but I am not certain.

Alternatively, 9603.50.00 covers brushes that are parts of machines or vehicles. A broom attachment mounted on a forklift fits "brushes constituting parts of vehicles". Still, the attachment is an implement of the vehicle, not a part. I am not sure which one CBP chose, but I think the ruling classified it under 9603.90.8050 as other brooms and brushes.

The kit is imported unassembled but complete, so it is classified as the assembled article.

I'll go with 9603.90.8050.

predicted_reason: The unassembled but complete kit is classified as the finished industrial push broom (a broom/brush with steel frame and polypropylene bristles) under heading 9603 as other brooms and brushes, not as a part of a machine or vehicle.
